review_method: All 14 QA98 pages directly inspected; all 14 QA99 rendered-page SHA-256 values identical to those inspected pages. README-only change; full suite rerun.

page_notes.1: Abstract gives aggregate-only scope, absolute component means, bounded run-count difference and failed classifier screen; clean title/author and introduction.
page_notes.2: Stored-ID grouping and unresolved electronics semantics explicit. Revised geometry figure, labels and caption fit; no electronic-ganging inference.
page_notes.3: Population/access limitations and full architecture diagram readable; all stage arrows and caption visible.
page_notes.4: Response, activity and flow equations fit; floor distortion and centered target/common-offset noise distinction stated.
page_notes.5: Solver and graph/count/sampler equations readable; no overflow.
page_notes.6: Decoder and training/loss/checkpoint explanations complete; mathematical identities and seed/batch values intact.
page_notes.7: Run-bound derivation, exact-event alternative, uncertainty and classifier protocol clearly connected.
page_notes.8: All original aggregate rows preserved; mean longitudinal figure and caption fit.
page_notes.9: Pooled widths, empty-cause ambiguity and ECAL-start rates fit with algebraic-bounds figure; ranges are not confidence intervals.
page_notes.10: Failed screens and numerical history retained. FP32 support equality explicit; three-layer example and correlated-upstream distinction legible.
page_notes.11: Threshold/timing applicability caveat, performance limits, conclusion, availability, acknowledgment and author/AI declarations all fit.
page_notes.12: Appendix A hashes, calibration weights and historical split/reproducibility limits readable.
page_notes.13: Expanded eight-column energy table legible; all bins/SDs and classifier seeds intact; scored-row twin probability stated.
page_notes.14: All 25 citations and new publication metadata fit without clipped bibliography text.

boundary: Document/rendering/algebra QA only; no new event-level or physical validation.
